## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Verona, Italy. It starts at Viale Postumia 71.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Museo Nicolis is a tribute to the tools of traffic and is jam-packed with vehicles which trace the evolution of transport. In fact, this private collection is so extensive that it's a wonder they even found the _vroom_ for it all!
>
> See hundreds of vintage cars, bikes, motorcycles, and even small aircraft in eight exhibits. That's not all – immerse yourself in a world of mechanical antique treasures which include cameras, typewriters, and musical instruments. It's a collection of curiosities!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €15.75. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 62 ratings and 41 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
